title: Corran
description: A little boy with Force sensitivity, Corran lived on Daiyu with his mother. Con man Haja Estree arranged passage for them to get off of the planet and on to Jabiim. The two escaped the Galactic Empire's attack on Jabiim on Kawlan Roken's ship. They eluded the Empire after Obi-Wan Kenobi provided a distraction to attract the attention of Darth Vader.
